address_corrections.name: SETPROJ
evidence: Preserves form RCX, path RDX, second path R8, and byte flag R9B at 0x11d943e..0x11d9453.
Assigns UnicodeString globals 0x16bcc90/0x16bcc98, calls published UpdatePathLabels 0x1363590 at 0x11d949e and loops over 49 recent projects.
Called by published RenameProjectBtnClick 0x13598d0 at 0x135a0e8 and ProjDataPathBtnClick 0x1364de0 at 0x13650f8.
The rejected candidate shares only a stack-probe prologue; three independently matched reference callers instead target the accepted address.

project_vmt.evidence: TFLProject RTTI begins at 0xed0da0; its class pointer at 0xed0dac is 0xed0c28.

limitations: No runtime access was performed by this analysis.
The previous 26.1.6.5639 binary was overwritten; comparison uses its recorded evidence, not an asserted binary-to-binary match.
Aggregate operand counts cannot establish object identity; focused disassembly and fresh runtime layout/behavior checks remain required.

abi_reviews.name: SAVEPROJ
observations: Preserves path RCX at 0x11dbe1c and flags DL at 0x11dbe6b; no additional incoming R8/R9 argument is consumed before the first nested call at 0x11dbe76.
The 0.70 initial mnemonic similarity is insufficient alone; the explicit argument review and one matched caller support the existing two-argument ABI.

abi_reviews.name: PATREFRESH
observations: Captures RCX object, DL and R8B into the same 0x38/0x42/0x43 stack fields as reference 0xd9a9e0.
The added early readiness call and atomic pending-refresh flag explain initial similarity 0.71. Existing three-argument call remains valid; five matched callers independently agree.

abi_reviews.name: FLPROJ_LOAD_SLOT
observations: Captures RCX self, RDX path and R8B flags; classifies the path against eight extensions and tests the save-prompt flag. Slot 0x40 matches the previously validated FL26 ABI.
The adjacent slot 0x38 is a different function at 0xed5c40 and must not be substituted.

abi_reviews.name: PATOP_EDIT_SLOT
observations: Captures self, open-array pointer RDX, bound R8, and action R9D at 0xed3e92..0xed3e9e. Uses dialog operation 0x402 at 0xed3f26 and mapped pattern table global 0x15e2aa0 at 0xed3f82.
Different stack allocation prevents the reference prefix signature from matching; its ABI, pattern lookup, VMT position and operation semantics agree with the previous FL26 review.

abi_reviews.name: MSGBOX
observations: Matches the mode-one wrapper guard and forwards to mapped MSGBOX_CORE 0x963520 at 0x9635bc.

focused_layout_reviews.observation: MUTE uses 0x28f times eight for the record address, enabled byte at 0x18, and independently increments by 0x1478 in its full-track loop.
MIXNAME and SETROUTE use effect-object pointers at 0x134c; SETROUTE forms route entries from record plus 0x394 and destination index times eight.
The selection-dependent reorder helpers called by MOVECHAN test channel byte 0x32c.
The channel note-edit path dereferences its grid at 0x7ac, accesses grid entries and invokes mapped NOTEARR. MOVECHAN refresh helper independently uses the same grid pointer.
BUSYBEGIN tests and stores the busy object at form offset 0x34d4.
NOTEARR multiplies pattern index by eight, three and eight, giving stride 0xc0, then tests/stores the notes object at 0x28.
MOVECHAN refresh path reads the playlist pattern-control pointer at 0xd34 before invoking mapped PATREFRESH.
Marker refresh accesses selected marker at 0xd8c; the uniquely matched form AddMarker helper reads the marker list at 0xd84.
Published TimePanelMouseDown and TimePanelMouseMove combine the integer horizontal scroll at 0xb14 with the double ticks-per-pixel at 0xb04.
Published TimeScrollerPaintKnob branches by editor mode to grid pointers at 0xd2c and 0xc68. VZoomSelectChange corroborates these pointers and the grid scroll offset 0x3fc.
The setters called by PLTRACK index tracks by 0x45 times four (0x114) and assign name at 0x24 and color at 0x2c.

format_review.observation: The reader still consumes 0xac then a uint32 event ID and dispatches by high nibble; the writer emits the escape byte then four ID bytes. The extended-event parser fix applies without alteration.

runtime_validation_required: Read-only live layout inspection against this exact new engine hash.
Fresh owned pair: project join/load/save, all pattern operations, notes, clips, metadata, mixer state, repeated FX state and sample transfer.
Cursor geometry and real editor interactions at the user display scaling.
Preserve compile gating and report the exact tested version; no support for untested future builds.
